name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 3.1V — SOT
description: Cluster of 2 surface-mount 3.1V low-dropout (LDO) linear regulator ICs in SOT package footprints.
selection_hints: Requires a fixed 3.1V low-dropout linear regulator IC.
Select between SOT-343_SC-70-4 and SOT-353_SC-70-5 footprint variants.
